sentences.text: You need to take these medicines to get better. You must take Spironolactone 25 mg by mouth once daily.
You must take Furosemide 40 mg twice daily (8 AM and 2 PM). You must not take Ibuprofen until your kidney function is rechecked by your cardiologist.
You must stop taking Lisinopril 10 mg daily. You must continue taking Metoprolol succinate 50 mg by mouth once daily.
If you have chest pain, shortness of breath at rest, or fainting, you must return to the Emergency Department or call 911.
If your weight increases by more than 2 lb in one day or 5 lb in one week, or if your leg swelling worsens, you must call the heart failure clinic at [PHONE_1].
You must weigh yourself every morning after urinating and before breakfast and record daily weights.
You must walk as tolerated; no lifting > 10 lb for 2 weeks.
You must follow up with the heart failure clinic with [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/21/2026 at 10:30 AM.
You must have a basic metabolic panel (blood test) on 10/18/2026 at the outpatient lab.

items.text: Tienes que tomar estos medicamentos para que te sientas mejor. Tienes que tomar Spironolactone 25 mg por vía oral una vez al día.
Tienes que no tomar Ibuprofen hasta que se reevalúen tus funciones renales por tu cardiologo. Tienes que tomar Furosemide 40 mg dos veces al día (8 AM y 2 PM).
Tienes que dejar de tomar Lisinopril 10 mg al día. Tienes que seguir tomando Metoprolol succinate 50 mg por vía oral una vez al día.
Si tienes dolor en el pecho, dificultad para respirar al reposo o te caes, tienes que regresar al Servicio de Urgencias o llamar a 911.
Si tu peso aumenta en más de 2 libras en un día o 5 libras en una semana, o si tu hinchazón en las piernas empeora, tienes que llamar al servicio de atención al paciente del corazón en [PHONE_1].
Tienes que pesarte cada mañana después de orinar y antes de la comida y registrar los pesos diarios.
Tienes que caminar lo que puedas; no levantar más de 10 libras durante 2 semanas.
Tienes que seguir con el servicio de atención al paciente del corazón con [CLINICIAN_1] el 10/21/2026 a las 10:30 AM.
Tienes que tener un panel metabólico básico el 10/18/2026 en el laboratorio ambulatorio.
You have to take these medications so that you feel better. You have to take Spironolactone 25 mg by mouth once a day.
You have to not take Ibuprofen until your renal functions are reevaluated by your cardiologist. You have to take Furosemide 40 mg twice a day (8 AM and 2 PM).
You have to stop taking Lisinopril 10 mg a day. You have to continue taking Metoprolol succinate 50 mg by mouth once a day.
If you have chest pain, difficulty breathing at rest, or you fall, you have to return to the Emergency Service or call 911.
If your weight increases more than 2 pounds in a day or 5 pounds in a week, or if your leg swelling worsens, you have to call the heart patient care service at [PHONE_1].
You have to weigh yourself every morning after urinating and before eating and record the daily weights.
You have to walk as much as you can; do not lift more than 10 pounds for 2 weeks.
You have to continue with the heart patient care service with [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/21/2026 at 10:30 AM.
You have to have a basic metabolic panel on 10/18/2026 at the outpatient laboratory.
